sources.ref: FiiO Control web app 4.4.6 of 2026-11-21 (https://fiiocontrol.fiio.com): its model list, and the filter types, gain range and presets it gives this model

meta.notes: FiiO Control lists it as a beta device (added in 4.3.6, presets updated in 4.4.1): peaking and shelves only, gain ±12 dB. FiiO Control asks the device for its band count; 10 is the app's default layout, not a confirmed count for this model.
